title: Reachability set membership
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. The number $u$ belongs to the set of numbers below $2^{K(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}$ that are reachable from the initial configuration code by zero or more encoded $s$-window steps if and only if it is reachable from that code by zero or more such steps; here $K(N)$ is the fixed code-length parameter of $N$ and $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
